title: Virtual Compute: snapshot allocation handling scope
content:
## Scope and evidence

Virtual Compute snapshot allocation scope. For a request to correct a compute-managed shared snapshot line, record exactly one completed nonfinancial allocation linked to the original line and export. The recorded snapshot footprint exists before handling; the allocation is a desk calculation, not a new delivery. This scope requires a full UTC source month and a unique active backup holding throughout that month. This shared snapshot export scope requires integral GB-month quantities for every physical source slice. For the allocation action, evidence event reference identifies the unique completed review-subtype service-record packet whose original source reference is the original snapshot charge and whose related evidence reference is its exact snapshot export; the raw export itself does not occupy this packet role.
